text: Caciocavallo Silano is a cow's-milk pasta filata moulded by hand into a closed, smooth pear or oval, then tied in pairs and hung over poles to ripen; it firms from elastic to flaky and develops a straw-yellow rind.

steps.note: The milk is raw or thermised.
With calf rennet or kid rennet paste.
Natural whey starter is permitted, and the curd is soured until it can be stretched.

steps.name: stretch
steps.note: In hot water, closed by hand into an oval or cone of 1–2.5 kg.
The time is set by the weight.
Tied in pairs and hung on poles.
